study: Capsule Review: Galar fitting-pool label-only feasibility audit
discovery: After frozen v1.0 was committed, permitted training-pool CSVs 21-60 showed heterogeneous source-frame gaps: 21-38 predominantly step 5; 39-60 predominantly step 1. Applying one step-5 rule to all studies would miscount runs.
derive_stride_from: source frame identifiers only; never pathology labels
stride_policy: unique modal positive gap per examination; at least 95% of adjacent gaps
analysis_change: Count positive annotation runs when two consecutive positive annotated rows have source-frame gap equal to that examination's label-blind modal gap. Break at gaps and nonpositive/unknown rows. Report actual stride and support fraction for each examination. Run lengths remain counts of annotated rows, not time or lesions.
outcome_status: Exploratory descriptive training-cohort audit, not predeclared confirmatory evaluation. No pathology model fitting or selection on held-out exams.
source_data: Official Galar v2 corrected labels, same SHA-256 as frozen protocol. No additional medical images or other labels acquired.
